result.summary: S1 re-gate PASS. Independently reproduced the exact original negative case from scratch via real grammY dispatch: consent_pd_at and pending_source both NULL immediately after the deep-link /start, pending_source set only after the consent:agree callback and only after consent_pd_at was already non-null. Regression check confirmed the consented fast path unaffected. Ran 4 adversarial channel strings through the full round trip -- no crash, no corruption, no parsing ambiguity. Filed ISS-0010 (MINOR, non-blocking): the fixed callback_data prefix consumes 54 of 64 bytes, leaving only ~10 bytes for the channel string on the majority (first-time-user) path -- a real data-attribution quality defect, not a security violation.
